comment: The four formulas are at osculum.cpp:81 to :88. Wave 2 is 0.45 plus twice the phase times a sine, hard limited to ±1, so it is asymmetric and offset. Wave 4 reads an eight-entry random table filled in the constructor from the C library generator seeded from the clock (osculum.cpp:53 to :58), and its sign is flipped for the first half of each cycle.
